items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: I'm at Paul Barnes' home at 1770 North Doris-Newis Street.

ctx.x: Well, I'm Jane Julian, and this is March 13, 1971, and I'm at Paul Barnes' home at 1770 North Doris-Newis Street. Is that how you pronounce it?
That's correct. Doris-Newis? Yes, that's correct.

Yeah, and I'm interviewing him for the archive of New Orleans Jazz at Tulane University. Paul, I wanted to ask you some things. First of all, about your family. You have such an interest in family, and I don't think you've ever really been interviewed about them very much.
